generalized_learning.generalized_failure_pattern: Authority checked before long-running work is incorrectly treated as durable permission; after liveness expiry and takeover, the stale worker can still reach later irreversible or costed effects.
generalized_learning.plausible_wrong_implementation: Check lease/ownership only when entering a handler or only before its final outbound effect, while provider calls, domain writes, sibling outbound operations or terminal markers remain reachable under stale authority.

reusable_control.procedure: Suspend authority holder A past liveness, let B take over the same idempotency key, resume A before each effect class and require zero stale effects.

generalized_learning.prevention_rule: Treat current authority as a dynamic precondition of every external, irreversible or costed effect; revalidate immediately at provider, durable-domain, outbound and terminal boundaries.
generalized_learning.detection_rule: Adversarially suspend A beyond liveness, allow B takeover, then resume A before at least two distinct effect surfaces and require zero effects from A; a guard only at start or final outbound is insufficient.

transfer_cases.scenario: A resumes immediately before a costed external provider call after B takeover.
A resumes immediately before a durable state mutation after B takeover.
A resumes immediately before terminal completion after B takeover.
